title: Special permit to cut parking for 2950 West 24th Street, Brooklyn
summary: This application would allow a reduced amount of accessory off-street parking, from 167 to 143 spaces, for a proposed mixed-use development at 2950 West 24th Street in Coney Island, Brooklyn. It is one of four related actions facilitating an 18-story, roughly 334,300-square-foot building with 408 income-restricted apartments, ground floor commercial and community space, and open space. The City Planning Commission approved the special permit, and the Council held a public hearing on July 1, 2026.
